w:r.w:t: <!-- Health Connect (#200): its client library asks for Android 8 and Health Connect itself
needs 9. The app keeps running on older phones, where HealthConnectPlugin answers
<!-- Health Connect (#200) opens the app from its permission screen to say why the
permissions are asked for: Android 14 and up through VIEW_PERMISSION_USAGE, 13 and
lower through the Health Connect app's rationale action. Both land in the app. -->
<!-- Rest-over alarm. Explicit class, no intent-filter: only this app can send it. -->
<!-- Reposts the rest countdown every second so the notification shade keeps the
clock and a shrinking bar after the WebView is frozen. The lock screen shows
it only when the user allows notifications there. specialUse: this is a timer,
android:value="Shows how long is left in the rest between sets." />
<!-- The background check before a nudge or a reminder (NudgeCheckJob): asks the paired
server whether the day was trained elsewhere. Run by JobScheduler only; persisted
jobs survive a reboot through RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED (declared below). -->
<!-- Gym reminder (#614): the platform's proximity alert for a gym fires this (GymReminder).
Explicit, not exported: nothing but that alert's own PendingIntent reaches it. -->
<!-- Gym reminder: the short check with live location after the phone entered a gym's wide
approach zone (GymScanService). At most 15 minutes, at most 3 a day; its notification
is a silent one. Started by the approach alert's broadcast (Android 12+: only with
unrestricted battery or exact alarms allowed, see GymReminder.launchCheck), never exported. -->
<!-- Proximity alerts are gone after a restart or an app update: registered again here.
Only the system sends these two broadcasts. -->
<!-- Gym check-in scanner (@capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning): pre-fetch the ML Kit
barcode model at install time so the first scan doesn't wait on a download. -->
<!-- Workout-day reminder: lets the local-notifications plugin fire at the exact minute
on Android 12+. Where it isn't granted, scheduling silently falls back to inexact
alarms 鈥 the reminder still arrives, just not to the minute. -->
<!-- Rest countdown (#296): the notification (asked for at the first rest on Android 13+),
the foreground service that keeps its clock, and the wake lock that lets that clock
reach the end on time with the screen off. The rest-over alarm uses the exact-alarm
permission above where it is granted; Android 14 no longer grants it at install, and
an inexact alarm can come most of a rest late, so the countdown sounds the end itself
and the alarm is only its fallback. -->
<!-- The buzz at the end of a rest or a hold and on a set tick (navigator.vibrate). The
WebView drops every vibrate call from an app without this permission, so the phone
stayed still. A normal permission: granted at install, no prompt. -->
<!-- Delete my account on a paired phone: the phone's own face, fingerprint or screen lock
confirms it is the owner first (DeviceAuthPlugin). A normal permission, no prompt. -->
<!-- The background check before a nudge (NudgeCheckJob) is a persisted job: it is still
there after a restart. Local notifications declare the same for their own alarms. -->
<!-- Gym check-in: scanning a membership QR/barcode with the camera. -->
<!-- Health Connect (#200): each asked for only when the user turns its switch on in Settings.
openGym writes finished workouts and weigh-ins, and since v1.4.3 can read back the heart
rate during a workout and weigh-ins from other apps (#544). Foreground only: no
background read permission. The history one (v1.4.4, idea from #801) is asked for
together with reading weigh-ins, where Health Connect has it, so the first read can go
further back than the 30 days before the grant; the read works without it too. -->
<!-- Gym reminder (#614), off until switched on in Settings: where the phone is, for "I'm at
the gym right now" and to watch the gyms the user added with the platform's proximity
alerts (no Google Play Services). Background location ("Allow all the time") is asked for
separately, after an explanation in the app, because the alert has to fire with openGym
closed. The places never leave the phone. -->
<!-- The approach check above runs as a location foreground service (Android 14+ names the
type), and asks the paired server about today only when there is a network. -->
<!-- Location is optional: a phone without GPS still installs the app (the permissions above
would otherwise make Google Play require the hardware). -->
<!-- Whether the Health Connect app is there, on Android 13 and lower. -->
